note: Tia — Missilis RL Defender, Burst I (40s datamined CD), standalone unit (no base counterpart). The cover tank: her whole kit keys off Cover HP, which the sim does not model (v1 boss deals no damage; no cover pool). TRIGGER PROXY (the load-bearing judgment, independently re-derived by the S2b blind reviewer): both skill1 lines activate 'when recovering Cover's HP'. The ONLY deterministic cover-HP recovery in the sim is her own skill2 'when using Burst Skill → Restores Cover HP by 21.41% of final Max HP' — so skill1 is keyed to burstCast, once per own burst. Deliberately NOT the engine's generic `recovery` trigger: recovery fires on ANY heal the unit receives (helm full-charge heals, a healer teammate), and teammate Nikke-HP heals are NOT cover-HP recovery — that would over-proc both the team Attack Damage buff and her own CDR (the shared-prior trap the blind reviewer flagged first). skill1: (1) self burstCdr 13s per proc — 'Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼ 13 sec, stacks up to 2 time(s), lasts 12 sec': the engine primitive is instant-seconds per activation, so each burst proc buys −13s (effective CD 27s). The SECOND stack + the 12s stack window need an external cover-regen proc the sim cannot produce → documented COLD residual (in-game effective CD is the observed ~20s, anis-star probe note 2026-07-13; the sim's 27s under-credits cadence, but team FB cadence in standard comps is gated by the B2/B3 40s CDs anyway, so the damage impact is ~nil outside double-B1 reentry comps). (2) all allies (self included) attackDamagePct 32.11 for 10s (Damage-Up bucket) — uptime 10s per burst cadence; passive cover-regen procs would raise real uptime → same COLD residual. skill2: UNMODELED except its trigger-anchor ROLE — the cover-restore NUMBER (21.41%) has no pool to land in; the cover-Max-HP/taunt hitCount-5 block and the 21.96% lifesteal are defensive/inert (carried verbatim). Burst: two shield EVENTS (no HP pool at scope; they fire 'shielded' triggers for shield-synergy teammates and open requiresShielded windows): self 35.07% + allies-except-self 10.21% of HER final Max HP, 10s; plus reenterStage stage 1 — 'Re-enters Burst Stage 1': the rotation HOLDS stage 1 after her cast so a second Burst-I unit can also cast this chain (the Tia + Anis:Star pairing; engine rotation stage-hold, sim.ts reenterStage handling). When no second B1 is eligible the stage advances — the real-kit no-op case. Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-28. Her skill2 lifesteal ("Recovers 21.96% of attack damage as HP") is recorded in "unmodeled" and emits no recovery event. ROSTER RULING (owner, 2026-08-10, faithfulness Tier 0 / D3): self-scoped lifesteal stays RECORDED and emits NO recovery event. A heal fires 'recovery' blocks only at its own block's targets, so a self-lifesteal reaches a consumer only if the CARRIER itself has one — and none of the five non-emitters does (the roster's only consumers are asuka's self atkPct 96.98/25s and crown's, which fires when crown is healed). Emitting would also turn a per-hit line into a hit-cadence event stream at an unmeasured cadence. Emit only if this unit gains a self-recovery block. Prior: docs/modeling-priors.md.
